Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters, clams, and mussels.

To enrich the artistic concept of the exhibition, we can adapt elements from the hip-hop genre to create a multisensory experience that mirrors the urban theme. The playlist’s characteristic beats can be translated into the rhythmic, percussive nature of the city’s hustle, while the lyrical flow can be reflected in the visual art’s composition, using layered textures and dynamic lines to represent the complex narratives of city life. The gritty atmosphere can be enhanced by incorporating raw, unpolished materials in the display, contrasting with the smooth, lustrous surfaces of the pearls, symbolizing the beauty that emerges from the urban grind. This integration of auditory and visual elements, along with tactile contrasts, will deepen the audience's engagement with the exhibition's theme.
